lfs.endpointUnsupported.en: The Git LFS endpoint configuration cannot be captured safely. Use regular UTF-8 config files without .lfsconfig includes and refresh.
lfs.endpointUnsupported.zh-CN: 无法安全捕获 Git LFS 端点配置。请使用普通 UTF-8 配置文件，移除 .lfsconfig 中的 include 后刷新。
lfs.endpointUnsupported.context: Immutable Git LFS endpoint snapshot guard

lfs.destinationChanged.en: The Git LFS destination configuration changed or was not reviewed. Refresh and choose the remote again.
lfs.destinationChanged.zh-CN: Git LFS 目标配置已变化或尚未核对，请刷新并重新选择远端。

lfs.trailingSpaceUnsupported.en: This operation cannot safely express a filename or pattern ending in whitespace. Edit .gitattributes manually for this path.
lfs.trailingSpaceUnsupported.zh-CN: 此操作无法安全表达以空白结尾的文件名或模式，请针对该路径手动编辑 .gitattributes。
lfs.trailingSpaceUnsupported.context: Git LFS trailing whitespace pattern restriction

lfs.historicalCommitRequired.en: Select a full, existing commit object ID for historical LFS content.
lfs.historicalCommitRequired.zh-CN: 历史 LFS 内容需要完整且已存在的提交对象 ID。

lfs.historicalFileRequired.en: The selected historical path must identify a regular file in that commit.
lfs.historicalFileRequired.zh-CN: 所选历史路径须对应该提交中的普通文件。

lfs.notPointer.en: The selected historical file is not a supported Git LFS pointer.
lfs.notPointer.zh-CN: 所选历史文件不是受支持的 Git LFS 指针。

lfs.historicalLimit.en: Historical LFS reads require a whole-byte limit between 0 and 64 MiB; 0 returns metadata only.
lfs.historicalLimit.zh-CN: 历史 LFS 读取上限须为 0 至 64 MiB 的整数字节数；0 表示仅返回元数据。

lfs.historicalSelectionChanged.en: The historical pointer does not match the selected object, or its path contains a comma or trailing whitespace. Re-select the historical file; comma paths require a Git LFS command outside this action.
lfs.historicalSelectionChanged.zh-CN: 历史指针与所选对象不匹配，或路径含逗号、末尾空白。请重新选择历史文件；含逗号的路径需在此操作之外使用 Git LFS 命令处理。

lfs.hint.en: LFS objects are separate from Git blobs. Status checks use the extension host and never download objects. Remote object availability is unknown.
lfs.hint.zh-CN: LFS 对象与 Git blob 分开存储。状态检查在扩展宿主执行，不下载对象；远端对象是否存在仍未知。

lfs.unavailable.en: Git LFS is unavailable in this host.
lfs.unavailable.zh-CN: 当前宿主不支持 Git LFS。

lfs.missingTool.en: Git LFS is unavailable on the extension host. Install it there separately, then refresh.
lfs.missingTool.zh-CN: 扩展宿主上无法使用 Git LFS。请单独在该宿主安装后刷新。

lfs.configured.zh-CN: 已配置 LFS process 过滤器

lfs.notConfigured.en: LFS process filter not configured; check host Git settings
lfs.notConfigured.zh-CN: 未配置 LFS process 过滤器，请检查宿主 Git 设置

lfs.invalidOutput.en: Git LFS returned an unsupported file record.
lfs.invalidOutput.zh-CN: Git LFS 返回了不支持的文件记录。

lfs.attributesUnsafe.en: The attributes file must be a regular UTF-8 file of at most 1 MiB. Symbolic links are unsupported.
lfs.attributesUnsafe.zh-CN: 属性文件须为不超过 1 MiB 的普通 UTF-8 文件，不支持符号链接。

lfs.invalidPattern.en: Enter a repository-relative filename or glob without traversal or control characters.
lfs.invalidPattern.zh-CN: 请输入仓库相对文件名或通配模式，不允许越界路径和控制字符。

lfs.untrackExact.en: No matching standard LFS rule was found. Review custom rules in .gitattributes manually.
lfs.untrackExact.zh-CN: 未找到对应的标准 LFS 规则，请手动检查 .gitattributes 中的自定义规则。

lfs.previewChanged.en: The repository, branch, or attributes changed. Refresh and preview again.
lfs.previewChanged.zh-CN: 仓库、分支或属性文件已变化，请刷新并重新预览。

lfs.selectionChanged.en: The selected objects are no longer in the current commit, or a selected path contains a comma or ends in whitespace. Refresh or fetch the whole current commit.
lfs.selectionChanged.zh-CN: 所选对象已不在当前提交中，或所选路径含逗号、末尾空白。请刷新，或获取整个当前提交的对象。

lfs.invalidRemote.zh-CN: 请选择已存在的命名远端。

lfs.branchRequired.en: This operation requires a current commit and a local branch.
lfs.branchRequired.zh-CN: 此操作需要当前提交与本地分支。

lfs.fetchHint.en: Download objects referenced by the current commit into the local cache. Working files stay as they are.
lfs.fetchHint.zh-CN: 将当前提交引用的对象下载到本地缓存，工作区文件保持原状。

lfs.selectedHint.en: Download selected objects from the current commit. Paths with commas require fetching the whole commit.
lfs.selectedHint.zh-CN: 下载当前提交中的所选对象。含逗号的路径需获取整个提交的对象。

lfs.checkoutHint.en: Replace current LFS pointers using objects already cached locally. No download; modified working files are protected by Git LFS.
lfs.checkoutHint.zh-CN: 使用本地已缓存对象替换当前 LFS 指针，不下载对象；Git LFS 会保护已修改的工作区文件。

lfs.pullHint.en: Run LFS pull for the current branch: download LFS objects and restore working files. Git commits are not fetched or merged.
lfs.pullHint.zh-CN: 对当前分支执行 LFS pull：下载 LFS 对象并还原工作区文件，不获取或合并 Git 提交。

lfs.pushHint.en: Upload LFS objects for the current local branch to the selected remote. This does not push Git branch references. AlwayGit does not rerun failed commands; Git LFS uses its minimum internal retry setting.
lfs.pushHint.zh-CN: 向所选远端上传当前本地分支的 LFS 对象，不推送 Git 分支引用。AlwayGit 不自动重跑失败命令；Git LFS 使用其最小内部重试设置。

lfs.cap.en: The file list is limited to the first 1,000 entries.
lfs.cap.zh-CN: 文件列表最多显示前 1,000 条。

lfs.selectFile.context: Git LFS file selection accessible name

lfs.available.context: Git LFS cache presence without hash verification

lfs.empty.en: No LFS files found in the current index.
lfs.empty.zh-CN: 当前索引中没有发现 LFS 文件。

lfs.statusTitle.en: Git LFS status and pending upload candidates
lfs.statusTitle.zh-CN: Git LFS 状态与待上传候选对象

lfs.pendingHint.en: Git LFS determines pending candidates from local refs and configuration. This is not a check of remote object availability.
lfs.pendingHint.zh-CN: Git LFS 根据本地引用和配置判断待上传候选项，此结果不代表已核对远端对象是否存在。
lfs.pendingHint.context: Git LFS pending versus remote distinction

lfs.trackHint.en: Rules edit only the root .gitattributes and remain unstaged. Existing content is not migrated or re-added. Untrack removes only the exact standard LFS rule shown in the preview; custom rules and nested attributes require manual review.
lfs.trackHint.zh-CN: 仅修改根目录 .gitattributes，修改保持未暂存。不会迁移或重新添加已有内容。取消跟踪只移除预览中的精确标准 LFS 规则；自定义规则和子目录属性需手动检查。
